description_en: Asynchronously queries the sessions of an instance and collects statistics on the sessions based on dimensions
description_zh: 调用GetMySQLAllSessionAsync接口，采用异步方式获取实例当前会话数据，并按照不同维度统计会话信息
kebab_example: aliyun das get-mysql-all-session-async --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --node-id pi-wz954ryd8f8930000 --result-id async_507044db6c4eadfa2dab9b084e800000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMySQLAllSessionAsync

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL, and PolarDB-X 2.0 instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版和PolarDB-X 2.0实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

You must specify this parameter for PolarDB for MySQL clusters. If you do not specify a node ID, the session data of the primary node is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID。不指定节点ID时，默认返回主节点的会话数据
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The asynchronous request ID.

GetMySQLAllSessionAsync is an asynchronous operation. After a request is sent, the system does not return complete results but returns a request ID. You need to use the request ID to initiate requests until the value of the isFinish field in the returned results is true, the complete results are returned. This indicates that to obtain complete data, you must call this operation at least twice
parameters.help_zh:
异步请求的ID。
异步调用方式不会立即返回完整结果，首先需要调用该接口获取ResultId，然后使用返回数据的ResultId，重新发起调用，直到isFinish取值为true时，返回完整结果。即获取一次完整数据，至少需要调用该接口两次
parameters.name: result_id
